responsibility: Declares the Arm-specific D frontend support entry points and binds them to the D target-hook macros. It serves as the small interface layer between the Arm backend and the D frontend by naming the functions that provide D version tags and target-info handlers and mapping TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS and TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO to those implementations.
same_name_distinction: Is the small interface header that declares the Arm D hook functions and binds TARGET_D_* macros to them, unlike arm-d.cc which implements the D version and target-info logic.
